name: zmodel_init
description: Initializes material globals, selects the hardware render callback when a hardware renderer is active, marks software-path activity without rebinding the render callback, resets the render clip stack, and allocates the display-instance pool free list.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel display/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: The native smoke verifies the hardware renderer branch binds zModel::RenderNodeHardware, the software branch marks g_zModel_SoftwarePathActive while preserving the existing render callback, clip-mask stack reset, default pool capacity, allocated pool zero/free-list initialization, and in-use count reset.
